1.text: I'll be guiding you on how to correctly format a dialogue JSON.

2.text:
First off, you don't need to define every property in every single line. 
				If a setting doesn't change after it's introduced, you don't need to repeat it.

3.text: For example, if this NPC is the only one speaking in the conversation, there's no need to set their name every time.

4.text: You can also adjust how fast the dialogue appears using 'text_speed'.

fast_text.text: A smaller number means the text will type out faster.

slow_text.text: A larger number means the text will type out slower.

normal_text.text: By default, it's set to a comfortable 0.03.

end.text:
Alright, that's just about everything for now. 
				The dev is currently working on adding choices, so give them time.
